```{r}
library(tidyverse)

asv_table <- read.csv("bac_patho_species_abundance.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv("bac_metadata_paired.csv", row.names = 1)

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(asv_table), rownames(meta))
asv_table <- asv_table[, common_samples]
meta <- meta[common_samples, ]

# === pla_unique ===
bulk_samples <- rownames(meta)[meta$Habitat == "environment"]
pla_samples  <- rownames(meta)[meta$Habitat == "plastisphere"]

pla_unique <- apply(asv_table, 1, function(x){
  all(x[bulk_samples] == 0) & any(x[pla_samples] > 0)
})

pla_unique <- as.integer(pla_unique) 

# === PNP ===
asv_norm <- asv_table / rowSums(asv_table)

weights <- ifelse(meta$Habitat == "plastisphere", 1, -1)
names(weights) <- rownames(meta)

PNP <- apply(asv_norm, 1, function(x){
  sum(x * weights[colnames(asv_norm)])
})


result <- data.frame(
  ASV_ID = rownames(asv_table),
  pla_unique = pla_unique,
  PNP = PNP
)

#write.csv(result, "bac_patho_attribute.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```



```{r}
da <- read.csv("bac_patho_attribute2.csv") 

da$group <- factor(da$Species, unique(da$Species))

counts <- table(da$group)

type_count <- as.data.frame(counts)

type_count$min <- 0

type_count <- type_count[, c("Var1", "min", "Freq")]


pla_unique <- da[, c("group", "Start", "End", "pla_unique")]

pla_unique <-list(pla_unique[pla_unique$pla_unique=="1",])


PNP <- da[, c("group", "Start", "End", "PNP")]

PNP <- list(PNP[PNP$PNP>=0, ], PNP[PNP$PNP<0, ])

circos.clear()
pdf(str_c('bac_patho_species_circoplot.pdf'), width = 8, height = 8)
circle_size = unit(1, 'snpc')

circos.par(track.height = 0, cell.padding = c(0,0,0,0), track.margin = c(0.015,0.015), gap.degree = 0, start.degree = 90)

circos.genomicInitialize(type_count, plotType = NULL, major.by = 1) 

circos.track(
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  track.height = 0.01,
  bg.border = NA,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector.index = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
    xlim = get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
    outer_radius = 0.98  
    theta = circlize(xlim[2], 0.5) 
    x_outer = outer_radius * cos(theta)
    y_outer = outer_radius * sin(theta)
    circos.text(
      x = xlim[2],                
      y = CELL_META$ycenter,      
      labels = sector.index,     
      cex = 0.8,                  
      facing = "clockwise",       
      adj = c(-0.2, 0.5),         
      niceFacing = FALSE,         
      col = "black",
    )
  }
)


circos.genomicTrackPlotRegion(pla_unique, track.height = 0.05,ylim = c(0,2), 
                              bg.border = "#3D4F6A", 
                              bg.col=NA,
                              panel.fun = function(region, value, ...){
                              
                       circos.genomicRect(region, value, col = "#EB7E60", border =NA)
                                })


circos.genomicTrackPlotRegion(PNP, track.height = 0.3, bg.border = "#3D4F6A", bg.col = NA,
                              ylim=c(-1, 1),
                              panel.fun = function(region, value, ...){
                               i=getI(...)
                                if(i == 1){
                                  circos.genomicRect(region, value, col =  "#EFB04B", border = NA, alpha = 1, ybottom = 0, ytop.column = 1)
                                }else{
                                  circos.genomicRect(region, value, col = "#7B9DBB", border = NA,alpha = 1, ybottom = 0, ytop.column = 1)
                                }})

dev.off()
```

```{r}
asv_table <- read.csv("fung_patho_top_200_species_abundance.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

meta <- read.csv("fung_metadata_paired.csv", row.names = 1)

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(asv_table), rownames(meta))
asv_table <- asv_table[, common_samples]
meta <- meta[common_samples, ]

# === pla_unique ===
bulk_samples <- rownames(meta)[meta$Habitat == "environment"]
pla_samples  <- rownames(meta)[meta$Habitat == "plastisphere"]

pla_unique <- apply(asv_table, 1, function(x){
  all(x[bulk_samples] == 0) & any(x[pla_samples] > 0)
})

pla_unique <- as.integer(pla_unique)  # 转换为 0/1

# === PNP ===
asv_norm <- asv_table / rowSums(asv_table)

weights <- ifelse(meta$Habitat == "plastisphere", 1, -1)
names(weights) <- rownames(meta)

PNP <- apply(asv_norm, 1, function(x){
  sum(x * weights[colnames(asv_norm)])
})

result <- data.frame(
  ASV_ID = rownames(asv_table),
  pla_unique = pla_unique,
  PNP = PNP
)

#write.csv(result, "fung_patho_attribute.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
